spells.name: Soulcoil Rite
spells.note: Raid-wide Shadow burst plus a stacking DoT every time a soul enters the well, and 5 energy to Nek'zali — unavoidable, so attribute deaths only, never a per-player failure

spells.name: Ritual Burn
spells.note: Pure aura, +15% mechanic damage taken per stack for 1 min (guides frame it as Rite damage specifically) — no damage events of its own, stack count is the add-leak scoreboard

spells.name: Soulcoil Ignition
spells.note: Nek'zali stirs the well herself, invoking four Soulcoil Rites back to back — the scripted healing burst and the marker that separates scripted Rites from leaked ones

spells.name: Soulcoil Ignition
spells.note: Second Ignition ID firing 1:1 with 1293664 — the periodic sub-component driving the repeated Rites; marker only

spells.name: Anguished Echoes
spells.note: SPELL ID NEEDED — knockback circles raining from the well during Ignition, confirmed as a dodge check by method.gg and expcarry but no distinct ID isolated, so no detection fires yet

spells.name: Essence Rend
spells.note: Genuinely Magic-dispellable — wowhead lists Dispel Type: Magic, method.gg calls it dispellable and the log shows 37 healer dispels (wow.gg's table disagrees; it is the weaker source). 15s Shadow DoT that drops a Latent Cultist where it ends, so dispel position matters more than dispel speed

spells.name: Possession Barrage
spells.note: Cast/target ID landing on the current tank — use it to identify the tank at each barrage; expcarry reports it also applying Hollowed on Heroic and above

spells.name: Possession Barrage
spells.note: Impact damage with a 300yd radius — it hits the whole raid every cast and only the amount varies with distance, so a hit count is meaningless; report damage taken per player instead

spells.name: Hollowing Strikes
spells.note: Tank melee DoT, 15s, stacking -5% healing and absorb received — wowhead confirms no dispel type. Some guides call the swing 'Sever' and the debuff 'Hollowed'

spells.name: Melee
spells.note: Boss auto-attack — non-tank hits are a positioning failure before Uncoiled Rage and expected noise during it

spells.name: Soul Transfer
spells.note: Nek'zali's half of the Ritual of Awakening handoff — intermission start marker

spells.name: Hungering Pyre
spells.note: Wowhead shows this as a dummy/server-side script with no player-facing effect — internal trigger only, never reportable

spells.name: Residual Toll
spells.note: Wowhead shows this as a dummy/server-side script targeting the caster only — internal trigger, not damage; the real Toll damage is 1298696

spells.name: Uncoiling
spells.note: Stage Two soft enrage — ticking Shadow damage on the whole raid every second until she dies; unavoidable, informational plus deaths

spells.name: Uncoiled Rage
spells.note: SPELL ID NEEDED — hard enrage at 100 energy (+500% damage, +150% speed, taunt immune); the pull-over marker, described by method.gg, wow.gg and expcarry

spells.manualCorrection: Difficulty corrected from Mythic-only to Heroic/Mythic on a first-hand report of the Heroic pull: Invoke is cast in phase two and sets the Latent Cultist puddles moving. The analyser most likely tagged it Mythic-only because no Heroic log in its sample reached phase two. This entry will be overwritten by the next raidlens abilities --boss nekzali --merge; re-check it then.
spells.name: Invoke
spells.note: Wowhead confirms an Interrupt Cast effect plus a Pacify & Silence aura on players; also commands the Latent Cultists to reposition (Entwined Step). Marker only — losing a cast to it is not a reportable failure

spells.name: Soulcoiled
spells.note: Wowhead shows mind control, pacify, silence, heal to full and +300% max health — the well taking a player over. Marker: log the application and whether a Rite followed

spells.name: Soul Exhaustion
spells.note: +300% damage taken for 1 min on players returning from the Immortal Coil — pure aura with no damage events; cross-reference deaths within 60s of an application

adds.name: Restless Amani
adds.note: Spirits possess the sarcophagus corpses and fixate on the Soulcoil Well. Wowhead lists NPC 261509 as 'Raised Amani'; the combat log name is 'Restless Amani'

spells.name: Gravebound Advance
spells.note: Absorb shield worth 25% of the add's health — while it holds the add cannot die or be stopped. Guides call it a magic absorb broken by magic damage; wowhead's effect reads Absorb Damage (All), so treat the school requirement as unconfirmed

spells.name: Corpse Blight
spells.note: Stacking Nature/Shadow DoT on the whole raid every time an Amani dies — wowhead confirms no dispel type; unavoidable, the price of killing adds

spells.name: Corpse Blight
spells.note: Eruption damage component of the same mechanic — informational

adds.name: Summoner Jawae
adds.note: Loyal Soulcoiler who raises the Tethers of Awakening at 50% and shields Nek'zali for the intermission

spells.name: Soul Transfer
spells.note: 15s channel transferring Jawae's essence into an Echo of Jawae — intermission spawn marker

spells.name: Tether of Awakening
spells.note: SPELL ID NEEDED — the link from each Echo of Jawae to the well that makes Nek'zali immune; severed by killing the Echo

adds.name: Echo of Jawae
adds.note: Intermission add. Each Echo holds one Tether of Awakening — kill all of them to end the Ritual of Awakening. Wowhead lists a separate PTR NPC 271337 under the same name; 263050 is the ID in the combat log

spells.name: Soul Transfer
spells.note: Echo-side half of the essence handoff — marker

spells.name: Soul Transfer
spells.note: The burst at the end of the channel — wowhead gives it a 300yd radius, so it is raid-wide and NOT a positioning failure despite the guides' 'get out of the path' wording; deaths-attributed only

spells.name: Hungering Pyre
spells.note: Cast ID for the soak circle — window marker for counting soakers

spells.name: Hungering Pyre
spells.note: The 10yd Fire soak damage itself — taking this hit is correct play, so it is a head-count metric, never a failure

spells.name: Hungering Pyre
spells.note: Debuff/soak-marker component — marker only

spells.name: Slithering Flame
spells.note: 8s Fire DoT thrown at players who did not soak the Pyre — wowhead confirms no dispel type. Every application is a missed soak and it is the fight's biggest killer

spells.name: Cremation
spells.note: 4yd Fire blast when Slithering Flame expires, burning Vessels of Awakening and Amani corpses in range — the flame carrier is expected in this data, everyone else is a failure

adds.name: Soulcoil Well
adds.note: The centre of the room and the whole point of the fight. Absorbs any spirit that reaches its surface and any player who dies in it, invoking a Soulcoil Rite each time

spells.name: Residual Toll
spells.note: Real Shadow damage at 300yd while the well siphons souls, leaving Hollowed after 16s — the encounter's baseline damage floor, informational

spells.name: Residual Toll
spells.note: The siphon aura itself — marks that a Toll window is active

spells.name: Swirling Spirit
spells.note: 5s Shadow DoT ticking every second on contact with a spirit inside the well — any application means somebody clipped the water

spells.name: Soulcoil Well
spells.note: Standing-in-the-well Shadow tick — zero events is the target on every pull

adds.name: Drowned Echo
adds.note: MYTHIC ONLY — the entity inside the Immortal Coil. Players dragged under by Grasping Depths enter a separate realm and must kill it to release the well

spells.name: Soulcoiler's Curse
spells.note: Kickable — 10s Shadow cast on wowhead and 14 log interrupt events against 3 completions. On completion it coils the whole arena, ejects everyone and leaves them Soulcoiled

spells.name: Grasping Depths
spells.note: Unlimited-range Shadow tick on everyone topside until the Drowned Echo dies — unavoidable, so deaths here read as kill-speed below, not a mistake above

spells.name: Immortal Coil
spells.note: The separate realm players are pulled into and the damage taken while inside — deaths attributed to the team below

adds.name: Latent Cultist
adds.note: NPC ID NEEDED — never appeared as a caster in the sampled logs. Spawned where Essence Rend ends; explodes on spawn and leaves a persistent slow zone

spells.name: Latent Cultist
spells.note: Spawn explosion plus a persistent puddle dealing Shadow damage per second and snaring 40% — wowhead confirmed; any hit on any player is a failure

spells.name: Entwined Step
spells.note: SPELL ID NEEDED — Stage Two Invoke commands the Cultists to dance their puddles around the well; described by method.gg and expcarry, no detection until the ID lands
